feature: Login page restyled to the new violet split-layout design (form left, generic pre-auth 'Behind this login' rail right) -- pure visual restyle, same real auth calls as before.
notes: This manifest only asserts the new visual surface renders and that the real form fields/ids the auth flow depends on (#email, #password, [data-testid='login-submit']) are unchanged -- see auth/password-reset-guard.json for the forgot-password API coverage and copilot-readiness/money-path-login-direct.json for the full real-credential login+MFA path, both of which this restyle must not regress.

The design's resetCode/resetNew inline six-digit-code password-reset steps are NOT implemented -- investigation during #1348 found the real backend (`POST /api/auth/forgot-password` -> `POST /api/auth/reset-password`) is an email-LINK flow (1-hour token TTL, artifacts/api-server/src/routes/auth.ts RESET_TOKEN_TTL_MS), not a code you type back into this page. Only the email-request step and its 'check your email' confirmation are covered here.
